import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    m = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

    adj = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        u = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        v = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)

    color = [0] * (n + 1)

    for _ in range(m):
        p = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
        c = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

        # BFS de p para encontrar o caminho até q (árvore: caminho único)
        parent = [0] * (n + 1)
        visited = [False] * (n + 1)
        visited[p] = True
        dq = deque([p])
        while dq:
            u = dq.popleft()
            if u == q:
                break
            for v in adj[u]:
                if not visited[v]:
                    visited[v] = True
                    parent[v] = u
                    dq.append(v)

        # Percorre do q de volta até p, pintando cada castelo do caminho
        node = q
        while True:
            color[node] = c
            if node == p:
                break
            node = parent[node]

    print(' '.join(map(str, color[1:])))
